title: The Yang-Mills Mass Gap from One Bound at One Scale
description: We prove the mass gap of four-dimensional lattice Yang-Mills theory at strong coupling for every compact simple gauge group. For the continuum theories on tori we prove that a mass gap and a unique vacuum follow from one bound on partition functions at one physical scale. This bound is a lattice gap together with a count of states, which the gap alone does not give; a centre-vortex condition can replace only the gap among charged states, and the bound is open at weak coupling. The archive contains the Lean 4 project (300 theorems) and the Julia script (259 checks) that accompany the paper; the paper itself is not part of the archive. The continuum mass gap is not proved.
